description: Interface definition for the Myth Engine
purpose: Transforms significant events into persistent mythology that influences future world content

methods.name: generate_myth
methods.description: Generate a myth from a significant narrative event

methods.name: get_faction_version
methods.description: Get a specific faction's version of a myth

methods.name: get_active_myths
methods.description: Return all currently active myths in the world

methods.name: record_retrospective_myth
methods.description: Persist MythRecord as retrospective interpretation, with factual_world_truth_rewrite forbidden.

invariants: Myths derive from significant narrative events
Different factions may hold different versions
CosmicPatternSnapshot and DiagnosticEnvelope provenance is required for meaningful generation.
GenerationPlan is required before any materialized output.
source_ash_refs, diagnostic_ref, and generation_plan_ref must remain traceable.

inputs.name: cosmic_pattern_snapshot
inputs.description: CosmicPatternSnapshot required by ASH generation contract.

inputs.name: diagnostic_envelope
inputs.description: DiagnosticEnvelope required by ASH generation contract.

inputs.name: generation_plan
inputs.description: GenerationPlan required by ASH generation contract.

inputs.name: worldstate_delta_packet
inputs.description: WorldstateDeltaPacket required by ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: myth_seed_candidate
outputs.description: MythSeedCandidate emitted under ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: myth_record
outputs.description: MythRecord emitted under ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: social_distribution_delta
outputs.description: SocialDistributionDelta emitted under ASH generation contract.

ash_alignment_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_alignment_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide materialization; downstream engines and adapters must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
